reference_transcript: I developed a dry cough about six days ago. For the first two days, I had a temperature of thirty-eight degrees Celsius and felt very tired. Do you still have a fever? Are you short of breath? The fever has settled. I do not have difficulty breathing while resting, but I sometimes feel slightly short of breath after climbing stairs. Do you smoke, or do you have a history of asthma? No, I do not smoke, and I have never been diagnosed with asthma. At the moment, continue resting and drinking plenty of fluids. You may take paracetamol five hundred milligrams if the fever or body aches return. I am not prescribing antibiotics today. How long should I wait before coming back? If the cough is still present after another five days, arrange a follow-up appointment. Come back earlier if the fever returns, your breathing becomes difficult, or your symptoms significantly worsen.
